speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the nature of your cough, and do you have any fever or chest pain? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Chest X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC 9,000 /μL, Hemoglobin 14.0 g/dL, Platelets 230,000 /μL; Chest X-Ray: Bilateral interstitial infiltrates suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any worsening of your breathlessness with exertion? REQUEST TEST: Pulmonary Function Tests (PFTs).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pulmonary Function Tests: Reduced FVC and FEV1 with a normal FEV1/FVC ratio, indicating a restrictive pattern.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you been exposed to any environmental toxins, such as asbestos or silica, or do you have a history of autoimmune diseases like rheumatoid arthritis? REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune Panel (ANA, RF, CCP).

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; since your autoimmune panel is normal, we can likely rule out connective tissue diseases. Have you ever worked in a job involving mining, construction, or shipyards where you might have been exposed to dust or asbestos? DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)
